slides.heading: Longest Increasing Subsequence
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Very Hard · Dynamic Programming
slides.narration: Let's solve Longest Increasing Subsequence, a very hard dynamic programming problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: One strictly increasing subsequence of maximum length (patience sorting with predecessor links).
slides.narration: Here's the problem. One strictly increasing subsequence of maximum length (patience sorting with predecessor links).

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: Patience sorting: keep the smallest possible tail for each length and binary search where each number goes.
slides.narration: Patience sorting: keep the smallest possible tail for each length and binary search where each number goes.

slides.heading: Approach
slides.narration: Step by step. First, tails array of indices. Second, binary search the position. Third, record predecessors. Fourth, rebuild from the last tail.

slides.heading: Complexity
slides.narration: Time is O of n log n. Space is O of n.
